items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: I think she was a big one. She had a sound. She could sing.

ctx.x: You had a review of what, ten girls dancing. And you had individual artists like singers and tap dancers. You know, things like that. Bill Robinson's dancing now playing songs. You had tumblers. An act that used to tumble. And every two weeks they changed the show. Then another show. But you keep the same chorus. But new stars would come in every week. That was Ada Brown, I think. Ada Brown, that's her. That's her.
